description: This bar chart illustrates Shapley values for different model architectures—mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM—across several relative positions to a target word. The horizontal axis represents the relative position, labeled as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, presented in that order, with no apparent sorting; the vertical axis represents Shapley value, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and labeled in units of “Shapley value” with tick marks at 20-unit intervals.  The chart utilizes grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a relative position and containing bars for each model; mBERT is represented by a light blue color, XLM-R by a dark blue color, and chLSTM by a light green color. At position L₄⁺, mBERT has a bar height of approximately 2, XLM-R is around 1, and chLSTM is below 1. At position T, mBERT's bar reaches approximately 60, XLM-R’s is at approximately 58, and chLSTM’s reaches approximately 72.  The tallest bar in the chart is the chLSTM bar at position T, reaching just above the 70 mark; the shortest bars are clustered around the zero value for positions L₃, L₂, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. No bars are visibly emphasized through shading, boldness, outlining, or annotation.
